title: Maximum Value of a String in an Array
summary: Determine the highest value among strings in an array, where value is the numeric value of the string if it consists solely of digits, or its length otherwise.
statement: Determine the highest value among strings in an array, where value is the numeric value of the string if it consists solely of digits, or its length otherwise.
constraints: A string containing only decimal digits has its integer value.
Any string containing a letter has value equal to its length.
Return the greatest value among all strings.
reference_solution:
def maximum_string_value(strs):
    return max(int(text) if text.isdigit() else len(text) for text in strs)
hints: Use a digit-only check before parsing as an integer.
Otherwise use the string length; take the maximum across results.
The two cases partition all allowed strings and directly implement their defined values.
editorial: The two cases partition all allowed strings and directly implement their defined values.

tests.explanation: The mixed string alic3 has length five, exceeding all numeric values.
Every string is numeric with integer value one, so the maximum is one.
